Sri Lankan Captain Athapaththu Takes 7 Wickets, Hat-Trick in Historic Asia Cup Match

Sri Lankan captain Chamari Athapaththu achieved a historic feat by taking seven wickets, including a hat-trick, against Indonesia in the Women's Asia Cup. Her performance was instrumental in her team's success in the match. The event highlighted Athapaththu's exceptional bowling capabilities.
